turns.assessment: svc298 depends on the S21–S08 lightpath, whose monitored physical route reaches S20 over the S01–S20 line. At onset, OSC was lost on both directional fibres of the span adjacent to S20 (O105/O107), with corresponding downstream amplifier input LOS and widespread OCH LOS. The abrupt, bidirectional loss strongly localizes the failure to a physical cable cut on that span; stable upstream amplifier pump/current measurements argue against amplifier failure, and a ROADM/WSS fault would not explain OSC loss.

proposals.rationale: O105 reports OSC_LOS on this span while O107 reports OSC_LOS on its reverse-direction mate at exactly the same time. The downstream LOS and affected S21–S08 channel are the expected consequences of both fibres of the S01–S20 cable being cut.
A sufficiently large sudden added loss could also suppress both payload and OSC, but simultaneous complete loss in both cable directions is much more characteristic of a fibre cut.
